purpose: Test whether evidence-responsive replanning changes operational survey performance relative to precommitting the same Frontier strategy at t0.
research_question: Holding incident, initial belief, planner heuristic, budget, effort, hidden truth and potential field outcomes fixed, does evidence-responsive replanning improve delimitation relative to locking all future missions at t0?

case_contract.interpretation: These cases were already used in R8. R10 is therefore a secondary paired analysis, not a new untouched external test.

shared_contract.confirmed_initial_detection_rule: The already-confirmed incident seed site is pre-masked in both arms and cannot consume R10 delimitation-survey budget.

static_arm.name: static_frontier
static_arm.precommitment_rule: At t0, select three distinct sites sequentially from the same initial GraphState and initial belief. After each precommitted selection, only the already-selected site is made infeasible for the next selection. No field observation or posterior update may influence the remaining precommitted sites.

adaptive_arm.name: adaptive_frontier
adaptive_arm.replanning_rule: After each field observation, update the spatial posterior, rebuild observable GraphState, mark already-visited sites infeasible, and run the same FrontierPlanner again.

paired_observation_randomness.uniform_definition: Interpret the first 8 bytes of SHA-256(key) as an unsigned big-endian integer and divide by 2^64, yielding u in [0,1).
paired_observation_randomness.detection_rule: detection = occupied AND u(case_id, site_id) < 1 - (1 - q_true)^6
paired_observation_randomness.reason: If both arms survey the same site in the same case, they must receive the same potential field outcome regardless of policy-dependent action order.

interpretation_guardrails.adaptive_positive_ci: Supports operational value of evidence-responsive replanning under the tested R10 benchmark regime.
interpretation_guardrails.ci_includes_zero: No reliable difference detected under the tested R10 benchmark regime; do not claim equivalence.
interpretation_guardrails.adaptive_negative_ci: Treat as a serious diagnostic result and investigate why evidence-responsive replanning degrades the tested operational metric.
not_supported: causal benefit outside the tested simulator and benchmark regime

post_result_change_policy.allowed_changes: Only implementation bug fixes that violate this frozen protocol, documented explicitly before rerunning.

pre_result_amendment.reason: Implementation guardrail tests showed that the confirmed initial detection remained feasible after frontier candidates were exhausted. R10 is a delimitation experiment that begins after that detection is already known, so the seed site is pre-masked symmetrically in both arms.
pre_result_amendment.timing: Made after implementation unit tests and before any R10 benchmark case was run.
